intents.title: Document Supported Languages and Extensibility in SPEC.md
intents.description: Document AFWE's two-tier language model (Tier 1 Tree-Sitter AST symbols vs Tier 2 file/regex structural analysis), zero-code tracking for new extensions, and the 10-minute Tree-Sitter extension procedure.

claims.statement: docs/SPEC.md explicitly documents Tier 1 and Tier 2 supported languages and the 3-step Tree-Sitter addition procedure
